name: Archie
source:
This cute bird is Albion's familiar, a loyal friend always ready to carry messages and dive advice. Archie is really proud of his master's dedication, but that is also a source of worry for him, since Albion tends to neglect his own health for the sake of his work.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/LiryaRhys/status/1491036442046627841]Twitter[/url]]
